verdict.rationale: Pika documents agent-facing entry points: an official MCP server agents can connect to, a single API across 100+ models, and a machine-readable llms.txt. Together these suggest an agent can submit generation prompts from within its conversation. The pack has no documentation of job-status polling, asset retrieval endpoints or URLs, or per-job cost or credit reporting, so most of the loop is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented job submission parameters, job status/watch mechanism, asset fetch/download, per-job cost or credit reporting via API/MCP, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost
